last_delivered_candidate.name: Bounded subset sampling and truthful termination evidence
last_delivered_candidate.upstream_basis: New upstream d5448af72 explicitly forbids unsupported subset CoV stopping. Pinned SubsetSampling source and R-S tests confirm per-level rather than global sampling limits. The existing subset path now guards exact point calls and rejects incomplete-domain results without a pin upgrade.

reviewed_candidates.name: SubsetSampling budget and termination correction
reviewed_candidates.reason: Reproduced a fivefold overrun and contradictory stopping claims on the fresh baseline. Stable bounded correction validates against the official R-S model and an independent analytical probability.

reviewed_candidates.name: StandardSpaceCrossEntropyImportanceSampling
reviewed_candidates.reason: Stable and useful; fresh prototype confirmed adaptive population work. Repair existing reliability guarantees first, then add auxiliary-density/weight and degeneracy diagnostics.

reviewed_candidates.name: LHSExperiment and LowDiscrepancyExperiment
reviewed_candidates.reason: Stable independent-input design closes an engineering workflow gap; stratification verified against the pin. Needs retained design identity and consumption, not a duplicate propagation estimator.

reviewed_candidates.name: RankSobolSensitivityAlgorithm
reviewed_candidates.reason: Stable and sample-efficient for first-order indices, but it assumes independent scalar inputs, overlaps the existing Sobol question, and scored 74/100 below the normal admission threshold.

reviewed_candidates.name: HSICEstimatorConditionalSensitivity
reviewed_candidates.reason: Stable weighted V-statistic, but effective-weight coverage and an unambiguous within-domain interpretation are needed; below threshold compared with existing-method correction.

reviewed_candidates.name: Bootstrap NLLS parameter uncertainty
reviewed_candidates.reason: New documentation clarifies defaults, but current calibration already explicitly disables bootstrap. Needs bounded repeated fits and empirical uncertainty validation.

reviewed_candidates.name: Tail fitting and return-level workflow
reviewed_candidates.reason: Threshold/block selection, independence assumptions and bounded profile-likelihood diagnostics require a more coherent workflow than another marginal factory.

reviewed_candidates.name: Field/process/Karhunen-Loeve workflow
reviewed_candidates.reason: Mesh and process provenance/persistence are missing from the current scalar/vector model journey.

reviewed_candidates.name: Shapley effects
reviewed_candidates.reason: No stable Shapley-effect API exists in the installed OpenTURNS pin.

reviewed_candidates.name: LineSampling, QuantileConfidence, Kent and new distribution factories
reviewed_candidates.reason: LineSampling and QuantileConfidence stabilized only on unreleased 1.28 development; Kent and new factories are new development functionality. None is a stable API in the installed pin.
